_comment: Licences a dependency may carry, and the packages allowed anyway. Freegle's code is AGPL-3.0-or-later (see NOTICE), so a shipped dependency must be compatible with that. Read by scripts/check-dependency-licences.mjs. Development-only packages (npm dev, Composer packages-dev) are not checked: they are never combined with the code we convey.

_why_not.GPL-2.0-only: Cannot be combined with GPL version 3 or the AGPL.
_why_not.EPL-1.0, EPL-2.0: The FSF lists the Eclipse Public License as incompatible with the GPL.
_why_not.Elastic-2.0, BUSL-1.1, SSPL-1.0, FSL-1.1: Source-available, not free software: they restrict use.

npm:add-to-calendar-button.reason: Kept because it works across the app, the web and different handsets. NOTICE grants an AGPL section 7 permission to combine with it.

npm:handsontable.reason: ModTools support groups list. Being removed in PR #1823; delete this entry when it merges.

npm:@sentry/cli.reason: Build tool that uploads source maps. It is run, never shipped or combined with our code.

npm:@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk.reason: Used by monitor-fsm, which runs on our own machines. It is installed by whoever runs it, not shipped with the code.

npm:combine-errors.reason: Declares no licence in package.json; its repository is MIT. Pulled in by tus-js-client.

npm:simple-mime.reason: Declares no licence in package.json; its LICENSE file is MIT.

composer:simple-as-fuck/laravel-lock.reason: Declares no licence in composer.json; its GitHub repository is Unlicense.

_exception_prefixes: A package whose key starts with one of these prefixes takes the named exception, such as the per-platform builds of a package.
